definition: On a hedging account, close a position against an opposite position of the same market, in one operation, instead of with a market order.
boundaries: It needs a hedging account; a netting account has no opposite position to close by. It saves one spread on the pair; it is an exit form, not a rule for when to exit. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: Two opposite trades cancel each other out.

sources.quote: closing the main trade by the volume of the triggered pending order
